selected_evidence.requirement: SSH allowed from any address on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed ssh service already allowed in public zone with no source restriction; post-firewall-change test from node3 (a non-node2 address) shows TCP connect to port 22 succeeds (raw connect + banner wait), proving SSH remains open to any source.

selected_evidence.requirement: TCP/9000 allowed only from node2 on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Permanent rich rule (priority -100) added accepting TCP/9000 from 10.100.50.11/32; live listener test from node2 (10.100.50.11) returns HTTP 200, confirming access is allowed.

selected_evidence.requirement: TCP/9000 rejected from node3 and everywhere else on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Permanent rich rule (priority 100) added rejecting TCP/9000 from any source; live listener test from node3 (10.100.50.12) returns connection refused (curl exit 7), confirming reject behavior for non-node2 sources.

Permanent config and systemctl-enabled firewalld confirmed pre-reboot; after node1 restart, firewall-cmd --list-all shows both rich rules still present, and live retest again shows node2 allowed (200) / node3 rejected (exit 7).

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id=03408ac4...; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; node briefly unreachable (connection timeout) confirming a real restart occurred; post-restart boot_id=c918be62... (changed); firewalld active and rules intact; traffic tests re-confirm correct allow/reject behavior post-recovery.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id=d9f8550d...; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable mid-restart; post-restart boot_id=09bcfe4b... (changed); node2 responsive again and confirmed it can still reach node1:9000 (HTTP 200), proving network/service recovery.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id=19062a82...; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable mid-restart; post-restart boot_id=0f6477a6... (changed); node3 responsive again and confirmed it is still correctly rejected from node1:9000, proving both node recovery and continued correct firewall enforcement post-restart.
